# interior-architectural-scene-planner (reference summary)

## Purpose
Plan an interior architectural visualization scene (room layout, furniture, materials, natural + artificial lighting) before any modeling or render attempt.

Translate an interior architectural visualization intent (room or interior space planned for catalog, brand, or showcase) into a complete, structured room plan with an assumptions register. Distinct from `environment-establishing-shot-planner` (outdoor/wide places; an establishing shot of an interior room belongs HERE when furniture and surfaces dominate), `product-hero-scene-planner` (single manufactured product), and `character-portrait-scene-planner` (single subject).

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/interior-architectural-scene-planner/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/interior-architectural-scene-planner/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `scene-planners` / `interior-archviz-scene-architect`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- intent is an interior room, space, or venue where furniture and surfaces dominate (including interior establishing shots)
- architectural visualization, catalog, brand showcase, hospitality, or residential room planning
- before any modeling, furniture sourcing, or rendering

## Trigger cues
- "interior of"
- "living room scene"
- "office showcase"
- "hotel lobby"
- "kitchen showroom"

## When not to use
- outdoor establishing → delegate to `environment-establishing-shot-planner` (`references/skills/environment-establishing-shot-planner.md`; use environment-establishing-shot-planner)
- single hero product → delegate to `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skills/product-hero-scene-planner.md`; use product-hero-scene-planner)
- character portrait → delegate to `character-portrait-scene-planner` (`references/skills/character-portrait-scene-planner.md`; use character-portrait-scene-planner)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `locked_3d_brief` (`object`): Locked 3D brief specifying room type, architectural style, focal zone, and daylight/artificial mood
- `room_dimensions_and_openings` (`object`): Architectural envelope, window/door openings, and primary furniture anchor zones

### Optional inputs
- `sourced_furniture_and_finish_assets` (`array`): Available furniture and architectural material assets from blender-asset-discovery-planner

### Primary outputs
- `interior_zone_and_circulation_plan`
- `window_portal_and_fixture_lighting_plan`
- `two_point_vertical_camera_constraints`

## Quick-start procedure
1. lock style early and pin room type + plausible room dimensions (never invent dimensions; record any defaults in the assumptions register)
2. pin architecture basics (walls, floor, ceiling, windows, doors)
3. pin furniture + props + material palette
4. pin lighting (natural + artificial mix) + mood + time of day
5. pin camera angle + lens
6. emit a structured plan with an assumptions register + handoff to `blender-asset-discovery-planner`, `glb-mobile-performance-budget`, `asset-style-consistency-checker`, and quality checkers

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Planning-only skill — does not model, source furniture, render, or execute Blender. Runtime status stays `Not Run` and artifact status stays `Not Produced` (downgrade-only, never upgrade). Hand off asset sourcing to `blender-asset-discovery-planner`, budget questions to `glb-mobile-performance-budget`, style checks to `asset-style-consistency-checker`, and validation to `composition-quality-checker`, `lighting-quality-checker`, `material-quality-checker`, and `blender-scene-quality-checker`.
- Model the room or geometry.
- Source furniture or download assets (belongs to `blender-asset-discovery-planner`).
- Decide performance or polycount budgets (belongs to `glb-mobile-performance-budget`).
- Audit cross-asset style consistency or validate composition, lighting, materials, or scene quality (belongs to `asset-style-consistency-checker`, `composition-quality-checker`, `lighting-quality-checker`, `material-quality-checker`, and `blender-scene-quality-checker`).
- Render or run Blender.
